## What's new

- Screens switch at once: no white flash, no glimpse of the previous screen and no delay when opening a page.
- Anki and audio, Bubble and Background work open with your settings right away, instead of showing another part of the page or the defaults for a moment.
- Every main button uses the pink accent.

Download `arm64-v8a` for most phones, `armeabi-v7a` for older 32-bit devices, or the universal APK. Android 11 or newer. The app updates itself from About → Updates.
